components.name: Polygon Containment Jurisdiction Engine
key_invariants: Ray-casting point in polygon algorithm handles outer ring and excludes interior holes
Boundary buffer threshold fixed at 100 meters (distance <= 100m -> status = 'near_boundary', station = null)
Nearest-centroid fallback is strictly forbidden and raises test failures if attempted

components.name: Lexical Statutory Retrieval Engine
key_invariants: Uses rank_bm25.BM25Okapi over title, keywords, statutory text, and legacy scraped text
Prunes candidates whose raw score ratio relative to top candidate is < 0.35
Splits compound complaints into clauses and merges top clause candidates (max_k=8)

components.name: Legal Safeguards & Pipeline Orchestrator
key_invariants: Non-penal / commercial pricing disputes strictly bypass penal retrieval
Explicit negation of weapons/violence/hurt zeroes Section 309 Robbery applicability
Section 173(3) BNSS caveats are attached to offences with 3-7 year punishments citing Lalita Kumari

components.name: Foundation Model Client & Fallback Router
key_invariants: Model: gemini-2.5-flash via google-genai SDK
Inference failures trigger bounded retry (3 attempts) before falling back to rule-based BM25
Outputs adhere to strict Pydantic JSON schema with reasoning and supported statutory elements

components.name: LangGraph Complaint Structuring Engine
key_invariants: Original statements are immutable and hashed with SHA-256
Every extracted fact must match a verbatim substring in the original statement
External tracing environment variables raise ExternalTracingRefused unless authorized

components.name: Deterministic Rule-Based Fact Extractor
key_invariants: Extracts facts across 7 categories (people, datetime, location, action, loss, witness, evidence)
Extracts exact start/end character offsets for every span
Classifies polarity as asserted, denied, or uncertain

components.name: Complaint Inconsistency & Contradiction Checker
key_invariants: Detects pairwise conflicts between statements on time, date, amount, persons, and identity
Prohibits defamatory or speculative wording (e.g. 'lie', 'dishonest', 'fake') in contradiction notes

components.name: Relational Persistence & SQLAlchemy Layer
key_invariants: SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM with connection pooling (pool_size=10, max_overflow=20)
Pre-ping connection health check and credential masking in URLs and exception logs
Alembic migration 001_initial_schema.py provides DDL scripts for 8 tables

components.name: Legal PDF Document Generation Engine
key_invariants: Two-pass canvas computes total page count ('Page X of Y')
Renders Section 6 statutory table with classification, punishment, reasoning, and elements
Calculates and returns SHA-256 document checksum

components.name: Police Station Email Preparation Engine
key_invariants: Associates station email formatted as ps.[station_name].mum@mahapolice.gov.in
Includes statutory notice regarding Bachpan Bachao Andolan for missing persons
Requires explicit user confirmation prior to dispatch; no auto-send
